home.noDevices: Connected, but no devices yet. Waiting for zigbee2mqtt/bridge/devices… (check the base topic in Settings if this stays empty)

banner.enterBroker: Enter your broker to see your devices.

weather.notConfigured: Choose a place for the weather in
weather.stale: Showing the latest forecast (the weather service isn't answering).

calendar.unavailable: The calendar is unavailable right now.
calendar.someFailed: Some calendars could not be loaded.

dashboard.hint: Press and hold a card to move it.

cardDialog.name: Name
cardDialog.nameOptional: optional, defaults to the device name
cardDialog.typeGrafanaHint: A graph or number from Grafana
cardDialog.grafanaUrlHint: In Grafana: the panel's menu → Share → Embed, copy the link or the whole iframe code. A link to a panel opened with View works too.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appTitleHint: Shown at the top of the start page and in the browser tab. Leave empty to use “{default}”.
settings.languageHint: Used for all texts the app shows. Names you set yourself are not translated.
settings.appearanceHint: Applies to this device only. Automatic follows the device's own light/dark setting.
settings.weatherChoosePlace: Search for a place and choose it in the list.
settings.weatherApproximate: Approximate position from your internet connection – check that it's right, or search for the place instead.
settings.calendarsHint: Paste an iCal link (.ics) for each calendar – e.g. Google Calendar's “Secret address in iCal format”, iCloud or Outlook. The link is kept on the server and isn't shown again.
settings.calendarMissing: Enter a name and an iCal link first.
settings.saved: Saved. Reconnecting with the new settings…
settings.fromConfig: Currently using values from the config file / environment. Saving here overrides them.
settings.backupExportHint: Everything you have set up: the home page and tabs, schedules, calendars (with their secret links), weather, language, title and the MQTT settings including the password. With a password, the file is compressed and encrypted – keep the password safe, it can't be recovered.
settings.backupDownloaded: Saved as {file}. Keep the password safe – it can't be recovered.
settings.backupImportHint: Replaces all settings on this server with those in the backup and applies them at once. The admin password is not part of backups.
settings.backupRestoreConfirm: Tap again to replace all settings
settings.backupPlainWarning: Without a password the file is plain JSON, readable by anyone who gets it – including the MQTT password and your calendars' secret links. Handy for looking inside; keep it somewhere safe.
settings.cardSizeHint: Height of the light and group cards on this device. Mini puts the icon, name and switch on one row.

auth.title: Log in
auth.hint: Log in to edit the home page and change settings.
auth.off: Login is switched off, so anyone on your network can change things. Set ADMIN_PASSWORD to require a login.

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.name: Name
tabs.kindCardsHint: Lights, groups, weather, calendar and Grafana panels
tabs.urlHint: Open the dashboard in Grafana and copy the address. It is shown without Grafana's menus (kiosk mode).
tabs.invalidUrl: Enter a http or https link.
tabs.embedHelp: Nothing showing? Set allow_embedding = true in grafana.ini and log in to Grafana once in this browser.
tabs.grafanaEditHint: Use the pencil next to the tabs to rename, move or remove this tab.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.hint: Turn lights and outlets on and off at set times or with the sun. The server switches them, so nothing needs to be open.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.needsOnOrOff: Choose when to turn on and/or off.
schedules.polarDay: Midnight sun in {place}: no sunset today
schedules.polarNight: Polar night in {place}: no sunrise today
schedules.noPlace: Choose a place under Weather to use sunrise and sunset.

errors.backup_not_backup: This is not a housecontrol backup file.
